page_title: SAS 0-2 NAP | Sassuolo v Napoli 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Giovanni Ayroldi has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+4' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

90+2' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Frank Anguissa (Napoli), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The substitution is prepared. Luca Moro (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andrea Pinamonti.
90' Substitution. Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) in, Domenico Berardi out.
89' Here is a change. Mathias Olivera is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
89' We are about to witness a substitution. Antonio Vergara (Napoli) is replacing Scott McTominay.
86' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
85' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and it's Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. It's a free kick to Napoli in a dangerous position.
85' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Alex Meret (Napoli) leaps to collect the ball.
84' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca will be replaced by Noa Lang (Napoli).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Billy Gilmour (Napoli) comes onto the pitch for Stanislav Lobotka.
81' Fabio Grosso decides to make a substitution. Josh Doig will be replaced by Fali Cande (Sassuolo).
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Armand Lauriente walks off the pitch to be replaced by Andrea Ghion (Sassuolo).
79' It is too late to protest. Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) knew very well what he was doing and subsequently receives a second yellow card, ending the match for him.
77' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) commits a rough challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for an infringement. Napoli will take a free kick near the side line.
77' David Neres (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Sassuolo earn a free kick.
76' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. David Neres (Napoli) replaces Matteo Politano.

75' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Giovanni Ayroldi saw the whole situation. Sassuolo win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Lipani departs the field of play to be replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
73' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
72' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
70' The referee blows for a cooling break.
69' The referee blows his whistle as Frank Anguissa (Napoli) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Sassuolo.
68' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli have a free kick.
67' The foul by Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Giovanni Ayroldi.
65' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Alex Meret.
64' Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.

63' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Giovanni Ayroldi with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.
62' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
57' 0 - 2 Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) shoots from the free kick just outside the box and curls the ball inside the right post. What a brilliant goal that is!
56' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Giovanni Ayroldi ignores the protests.
55' Matteo Politano (Napoli) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.

53' What a miss! Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
52' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli).
50' Two players stand over the free kick. Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
49' Dangerous play by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo). Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli get a free kick.
47' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Sassuolo, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
46' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) sees a yellow card from Giovanni Ayroldi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' What a chance that is! Scott McTominay (Napoli) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
45' A player from Sassuolo commits a rough challenge. Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Napoli have a free kick.
44' Matteo Politano (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
43' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Alex Meret makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
41' Matteo Politano (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Sassuolo, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
41' A corner kick by Napoli is thwarted by the well prepared Stefano Turati (Sassuolo).
40' Scott McTominay (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Napoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
39' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul. Sassuolo win a free kick.
38' Napoli are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
34' The Sassuolo players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
31' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) makes a strong challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Napoli.
31' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
30' Giovanni Ayroldi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ismael Kone (Sassuolo). Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
29' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
28' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Sassuolo will take a free kick.
25' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
25' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) brought his opponent down. Napoli have been awarded a free kick.
22' Rough tackle by Amir Rrahmani (Napoli). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo have a free kick.
22' Scott McTominay (Napoli) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Stefano Turati.
20' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) commits a foul after dangerous play. Napoli are awarded a free kick.

17' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Scott McTominay (Napoli) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Matteo Politano and planted his close-range header into the top right corner. Stefano Turati was helpless.

15' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom right corner, but Stefano Turati keeps it out with an amazing save. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.

15' A terrific piece of skill by Matteo Politano (Napoli) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.

14' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Giovanni Ayroldi no option but to blow his whistle. Sassuolo are awarded the free kick.
12' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
12' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Stefano Turati (Sassuolo) leaps to collect the ball.
12' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
11' Napoli are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
8' Matteo Politano (Napoli) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
5' Sassuolo force a corner. They send men into the box.

4' The game is interrupted. Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick is awarded to Sassuolo.
2' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) commits a rough challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Napoli.
1' What a big chance! Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Napoli will have the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi will supervise the game today.
